history.changes_cs: Jarvis dogfood pro WDUi Skin Editor doplnil SkinLibraryIdPropertyCoverage: skin-library id je bezpecna schema-backed textova vlastnost s validaci a Jarvis po dokonceni rezu korektne zastavi jako planning pass.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma novy recovery self-test pro prerusene worker journaly a release build overuje, ze obnova rozdelane prace nebere ukoncene nebo spatne pojmenovane zaznamy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a recovery self-test for interrupted worker journals, and the release build verifies that work recovery ignores completed or malformed job records.

history.changes_cs: Pridava okno Obnova prace v menu Nastroje: prerusene ulohy jdou zkontrolovat, znovu zaradit, oznacit jako opustene nebo exportovat bez spamovani chatu.
history.changes_en: Adds a Work recovery window under Tools: interrupted jobs can be reviewed, safely requeued, marked abandoned, or exported without spamming the chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pridava dialog Sdilene pracovni povedomi: v Nastroje lze zobrazit relevantni zdrojove chaty ze stejneho projektu, precist si duvod relevance a otevrit zdrojovy chat bez spamovani konverzace.
history.changes_en: Jarvis adds a Shared work awareness dialog: Tools can show relevant source chats from the same project, explain why they matter, and open the source chat without spamming the conversation.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis lepe predava SharedWork zdroje modelu: prompt obsahuje duvody shody a pravidlo, ze jde jen o read-only kontext z jinych chatu.
